notes.title: Brave Eduardo Beta v2 Update Now Live!
notes.content:
Great news from the front lines of development - we've just rolled out an exciting update to the Brave Eduardo beta on Steam, crafted by our dedicated trio. 
Here’s a quick rundown:

[list]
[*] [b]Combat Deck System[/b]: Experience the thrill of our new "Combat Deck" system, designed for simpler pick-up but harder-to-master gameplay.
[*] [b]Quest Log Feature[/b]: Keep track of your adventures with the newly introduced quest log, making it easier to follow your journey and side quests.
[*] [b]Lore-Rich Discoveries[/b]: Unearth books and letters that reveal the secrets of our world, enriching your experience and the story.
[*] [b]Upgraded Map System[/b]: With our enhanced map, exploring the vast lands of Brave Eduardo has never been more intuitive. Hopefully.
[*] [b]Fine-Tuned Difficulty[/b]: The first boss won't kick anybody's ass now...that easily now. Take that.
[/list]

Focusing on completing the game meant updates took a back seat, but we're back on track and eager to improve your beta experience.

If you're as excited about these updates as we are, consider adding Brave Eduardo to your wishlist and spreading the word. Every bit of support makes a massive difference for our small team.

Thank you for your patience and continued support. Let's make Brave Eduardo the best it can be, together!

Warmest regards,

John, Dhruv, and Matt
